description: Send events (message.received, message.delivered, message.opted_out, ...) to a URL: your app, a CRM, an automation tool. Returns the signing secret once.

description.description: A note on what the endpoint is for

events.description: Event types to receive. Omit, or send "*" or [], for every event. An unknown type is a 400.

numbers.description: Optional. Only events about these of your numbers (E.164): message events by their from/to, number events by phone_number. Events about no number (batches, credits, registrations) go only to endpoints without a filter. Omit or [] for every number.

url.description: The https URL that receives the events

name: create_webhook
title: Create webhook
